$comment: Briefs for every image of the site. tools/imagegen.mjs (OpenAI API) joins style + kinds[kind].style + prompt into one prompt; tools/art-brief.mjs writes the same briefs as ART-BRIEFS-CHATGPT.md (repo root) for ChatGPT. Change a brief here, then run `npm run art:brief`.
style: Original stylized game art for a dark, premium web app set in a post-apocalyptic survival world built from scrap. Semi-realistic 3D render with clean hard-surface modelling: worn painted metal, rust patina, rivets, bolts, scratched edges. Cool cyan rim light (#3DDCFF) with a subtle violet accent (#9B7BFF), warm brass highlights (#D9B467), deep graphite shadows (#0A0C0F). Crisp, high contrast, readable at small sizes, consistent lighting from the upper left. No text, letters, numbers or symbols with writing, no logos, no watermarks, no UI elements, no people's faces. Not cute, not cartoonish, nothing aimed at children. Not in the style of any specific existing game; no recognizable trademarks, brand designs or existing weapon skins.

crate.style: A single object, centered, three-quarter view from slightly above, filling about 80 % of the frame, soft contact shadow directly under it, nothing else in the scene, transparent background.

tile.style: Moody graphite-black backdrop. Portrait game cover illustration. The subject sits in the middle of the frame; the top fifth is calm, dark, low-detail space for a title overlay; nothing important near the edges, because the image is cropped to 3:4 and to 16:10 around its centre. Edge-to-edge scene, cinematic depth of field.

banner.style: Moody graphite-black backdrop. Wide cinematic banner. The focal subject sits in the right half; the left 45 % is dark, low-detail negative space for a headline. Edge-to-edge scene.

item.style: A single item as an inventory icon, centered, side view or slight three-quarter view, filling about 85 % of the frame, transparent background, at most a faint shadow. Bold silhouette and few large shapes so it still reads at 48 px. Neutral worn materials and no coloured glow: the site adds the rarity colour around it.

backdrop.style: Full-page website background that sits behind text and panels: very dark and low contrast overall, detail only as dim silhouettes in the bottom third, the upper half an almost empty night sky, no bright spot in the middle. Panoramic, so it can be cropped left and right.

avatar.style: Square profile picture: head and shoulders of a survivor whose face is completely hidden behind a mask, helmet or visor (no skin of the face visible). Plain dark graphite background with one coloured rim light. Centered so it still works cropped to a circle.

illustration.style: A small spot illustration for an empty state or a section header: one simple object or a tiny scene, centered, generous empty space around it, transparent background, readable at 160 px.
